research_findings: Discovered that the AI evaluation in StepByStepChat relied solely on a 'Try Again' modal state which clobbered the 'feedback' state on dismiss, leaving the user with no reference for what to correct.

Identified that 'textInput', 'listItems', and 'schemaData' drafts in StepByStepChat were only persisted into the LocalStorage session when a step was completed or skipped. Browsers crashes or mis-navigations resulted in loss of long-form responses.
features_improved: Persistent Constructive Feedback UX: Modified 'handleRetry' to retain feedback state and implemented an inline Alert Banner to display missed points while the user edits their submission.

Real-time Draft Auto-Saving: Implemented a 1000ms debounced effect in 'StepByStepChat.tsx' to continuously sync draft text, lists, and schema inputs to 'savedStepData', ensuring bulletproof crash recovery for in-progress work.
new_features_added: Debounced LocalStorage sync for text/schema draft inputs.
Inline Retry Feedback Banner for System Design Practice Chat.
next_steps_for_next_run: Stream LangGraph Evaluation responses to eliminate blocking 'Evaluating...' states during step submission.
Refactor Progress Server Actions to be fully asynchronous to further reduce UI blocking during step completions.
